name: table
title: Table
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Table. The table sits in a case; the header is an ink flat and stays in place while the body scrolls (maxHeight). Rows are split by a 1px line, never striped. Hovered row: a 3px ink bar at the row start; selected row (data-state="selected" or aria-selected): a 6px bar. Sortable headers get a brush arrow and aria-sort. Adds TableEmpty (a “…” mark) and TableLoading (flickering tone placeholders).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/table". It wraps your own components/ui/table, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: An ink header, 1px rules, and an ink bar for the hovered row.
meta.usage: import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/manga/table" TitlePages The long night24

props.name: maxHeight

props.name: sort
props.description: On TableHead: sortable column with a brush arrow (sets aria-sort).

props.name: onSort
props.description: On TableHead: called when the arrow button is pressed.
